title: Don't Say "How Are You?" – Say This Instead #shorts
description:
Don't say "How are you?" Say this instead:
• How's it going? (casual)
• How are you doing? (friendly)
• What's up? (very casual)
• How have you been? (after a long time)
• How's everything? (warm)

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
